criterion: Given a completed Download test is selected and its details have loaded, the summary shows the reported technology, user, handset, service, serving cell, duration, tested technologies, indoor/outdoor status, Download Rate, and Wi-Fi connection status.
steps_taken: Navigated to https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/launcher, verified the visible authenticated launcher, and saved this criterion's initial PNG.
Opened GIS, opened Automobile configuration, inspected its Test type choices, and selected Download.
Added Automobile - Download using the default date range, observed GET /api/platform/automobile/download/points return HTTP 500, and captured the resulting map/layer state without selecting a point.
Saved this criterion's separate final PNG and read its actual GIS URL before cleanup.
Removed the test-created Automobile - Download layer and verified no matching selected layer remained.
reason: Automobile exposes Download in its actual Test type choices. No Download point could be retrieved or selected, so a completed Download record and loaded summary could not be established. This is a point-retrieval service blocker, not a settled empty response or an observed detail-view failure. The map's Error legend entry is not an on-screen HTTP error message. No business data was created and no response was simulated.
